scoring_justification: Agent reports final numeric results; checker compares to paper gold with tolerances. Recomputing from raw electronic structure files is not required as the scored artifacts are the final spin densities and CASSCF mixing values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold spin density values from paper Table 1 and CASSCF mixing from paper Figure 3.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported AIM spin densities (Table 1) and CASSCF mixing (Figure 3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper text and solve.sh hardcoded accordingly.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual published numbers for the same quantities, verified against the reference solve.sh.

outputs.description: AIM-integrated atomic spin densities on the bridgehead and sulfur atoms for the three free ligands in relaxed and chelation-constrained geometries.
Maximum deviation from integer occupation (occupied–virtual mixing) from CASSCF(13,17) for the dtma radical in relaxed and fixed geometries.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported spin densities and CASSCF mixing values to paper gold values with suitable tolerances (±0.02 e for bridgehead, ±0.05 e for S, ±0.01 e for CASSCF mixing). The agent must execute the full DFT+QTAIM+CASSCF pipeline; the scored outputs cannot be obtained by guesswork alone.
